title: VTC Config — DID Hosting — List — payload
description: List the did:webvh hosting servers the community's VTA can publish its identities through. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

HostingServer.title: HostingServer
HostingServer.description: A did:webvh hosting server registered at the community's VTA, as that VTA reports it. Carries no credential.

id.description: The server's id at the VTA: the value that names it in the community's configuration.

Response.title: VTC Config — DID Hosting — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/config/did-hosting/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/config/did-hosting/list/0.1#response.
